From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — Lunacare (post-call follow-up)

Hi Anil —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Redwood is ready to start the SIG questionnaire you requested. I’ve attached a blank SIG export (LunaCare_SIG_v1.xlsx) to capture your initial responses.
- Primary clarifying items for your team to confirm up front so our security team can triage properly:
  1) SOC 2 status: Is LunaCare SOC 2 Type II completed, in progress, or not started? If completed, can you share the report (redacted is fine) or an AICPA letter?
  2) Regulatory scope: Do you consider LunaCare in-scope for HIPAA? Any GDPR data flows we should be aware of?
  3) Data residency: Do you require US-only data residency for PHI, or any specific regions?
  4) Subprocessors: Does LunaCare use third-party subprocessors for data processing (analytics, hosting)? If so, a short list is helpful.
  5) Retention & logging: Target retention period for logs/audit data and any specific logging requirements.

If you prefer, we can accept the SIG XLSX answers directly or point you to our shared CAIQ if that’s easier. Once we have the initial answers and any supporting artifacts (SOC 2, network diagrams), our security team (cc’d) will triage and aim to respond with any follow-up clarifying questions within 2–3 business days.

Proposed next steps:
- You: return the filled SIG (or attach relevant artifacts) by EOD Fri 6/4 if possible.
- Me: I’ll upload Redwood’s SOC 2 summary + security factsheet to the shared Drive and send over.
- Rishi: will take the lead on technical follow-up.

Attaching: LunaCare_SIG_v1.xlsx (blank questionnaire)

Thanks — look forward to getting this started.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

----
Original call notes (from demo):
- Use cases: document summarization for care teams, EHR integration via HL7 FHIR, occasional PHI processing for clinical notes (de-identified preferred).
- Expected traffic: pilot ~100k tokens/day -> production 1–2M tokens/day.
From: Anil Desai <anil@lunacare.health>

Cc: LunaCare Procurement <procurement@lunacare.health>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — Lunacare (post-call follow-up)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear notes — appreciate the recap. I’ve started the SIG XLSX and attached initial answers (LunaCare_SIG_v1.xlsx). Quick answers inline to your clarifying items:

1) SOC 2: In progress — LunaCare completed SOC 2 Type I last quarter; Type II targeted end of Q3 2027. We can share interim evidence where available.
2) Regulatory: We are HIPAA-aware and operate under a BAA for partners that handle PHI. GDPR: we have EU patient data flows via subprocessors for anonymized analytics — but pilot will be US-only.
3) Data residency: For this engagement we require US-only residency for any PHI.
4) Subprocessors: Yes — hosting on ACME Cloud (acme-cloud.com), analytics via BrightMetrics, identity via Okta. I listed these in the SIG file.
5) Retention & logging: Default patient audit logs retained 7 years; app logs 90 days. We can be flexible for pilot.

We don’t yet have your SOC 2 — can you share Redwood’s latest Type II report or the security factsheet you mentioned? Also please confirm encryption-at-rest and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (CMK).

I attached the partially completed SIG. Let me know if you want a quick 30m call with our security lead to walk through any questions.

Best,
Anil Desai
Head of IT & Security | LunaCare Health
anil@lunacare.health
+1 (206) 555-0123

Attachments: LunaCare_SIG_v1.xlsx

- Peak throughput: you noted ~100k tokens/day for pilot; can you confirm expected concurrency (requests/sec) and average request size? That helps us size logging/retention questions.

A couple items we’ll need from Lunacare to complete our assessment:
- Example request payloads (sanitized) showing fields and whether PHI identifiers are present.
- Expected concurrency and QPS for the pilot and production targets if available.
- Any specific contractual requirements around CMK or HSM-based key storage.

Estimated turnaround: initial triage ∼3 business days after we receive the example payloads and the completed SIG. If there are high-risk items (PHI in cleartext, unexpected subprocessors), we’ll surface those sooner.

Happy to join the technical sync — Thu 6/3 10:00am PT works for me. Camila, can you send a calendar invite?
